evidence.quote: The Group Health and Safety and QLWC policy signed in 2023 is leading Group entities to gradually adapt their occupational health and safety management systems (OHSMS) to comply with international standard ISO  45001. This metric considers the number of employees at entities reporting that they have an OHSMS audited by an external organization or certified according to ISO 45001 or its equivalent, as a proportion of the Group’s total number of employees.
